on_screen_text.text: NO NATION IN THE WORLD COULD ACHIEVE WHAT AMERICA ACHIEVED YESTERDAY.
ALL VENEZUELA'S MILITARY CAPACITIES WERE RENDERED POWERLESS
SUCCESSFULLY CAPTURED MADURO IN THE DEAD OF NIGHT.
IT WAS DARK, AND IT WAS DEADLY.
MADURO AND FLORES HAVE BEEN INDICTED IN THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF NEW YORK
FOR THEIR CAMPAIGN OF DEADLY NARCO TERRORISM AGAINST THE UNITED STATES AND ITS CITIZENS.
THE ILLEGITIMATE DICTATOR MADURO WAS THE KINGPIN OF A VAST CRIMINAL NETWORK
RESPONSIBLE FOR THE DEATHS OF COUNTLESS AMERICANS.
MADURO AND HIS WIFE WILL SOON FACE THE FULL MIGHT OF AMERICAN JUSTICE AND STAND TRIAL ON AMERICAN SOIL.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump announces that the U.S. military and law enforcement have successfully captured Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores. He describes a covert night operation where "the lights of Caracas were largely turned off" and says the Venezuelan military was rendered powerless. Trump states that Maduro and Flores have been indicted in the Southern District of New York for "deadly narco-terrorism." He calls Maduro an "illegitimate dictator" who ran a "vicious cartel" responsible for trafficking drugs into the U.S. and causing the deaths of "countless Americans," and asserts they will now face trial on American soil.
audio_music: The video's audio consists solely of Donald Trump's spoken voice. There is no background music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot with no cuts or camera movement.
central_claim: The United States has successfully captured Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, who are accused of narco-terrorism, and will bring them to face justice in America.
intended_effect: To evoke a sense of national pride and security, portraying the administration as strong and effective in neutralizing foreign threats and protecting American citizens.
uncertainty_flags: The audio of Donald Trump's speech has an unusual cadence and is somewhat slurred, making it unclear if this is his natural speech, a result of the recording, or potentially artificially generated.
